mapper.select:
SELECT notice_id, notice_content, memberIdx, notice_read, TO_CHAR(notice_sendDate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS notice_sendDate, TO_CHAR(notice_readDate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS notice_readDate
FROM Notice WHERE memberIdx = #{memberIdx} ORDER BY notice_sendDate DESC, notice_id DESC FETCH FIRST 15 ROWS ONLY
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Notice (notice_id, notice_content, memberIdx, notice_read, notice_sendDate) VALUES (notice_seq.NEXTVAL, #{notice_content}, #{memberIdx}, 0, SYSDATE)
